title: Initialize Rails 8 application with required stack
description: Bootstrap Rails 8 app with SQLite, Tailwind CSS, Stimulus, Propshaft. Configure for production deployment. Set up directory structure per technical requirements.

title: Install and configure required gems
description: Add gems: active_interaction (service objects), discard (soft deletes), audited (audit trail), nilify_blanks, view_component, stimulus-rails, turbo-rails. Configure each gem properly.

title: Set up RSpec test infrastructure
description: Install rspec-rails, factory_bot_rails, ffaker, shoulda-matchers, capybara, selenium-webdriver, database_cleaner. Configure RSpec with proper helpers and support files. Verify test suite runs green.

title: Set up code quality tools (RuboCop)
description: Install rubocop, rubocop-rails, rubocop-performance, rubocop-rspec. Create .rubocop.yml with project conventions. Run and fix any violations on generated code.

title: Create database schema for all domain models
description: Generate migrations for: properties, meters, visitors, users, stays, meter_reading_events, meter_readings, manual_consumption_entries. Include all fields, foreign keys, indexes, constraints per spec. Add deleted_at columns for soft deletes. Set up audited.

title: Implement domain models with associations and validations
description: Create ActiveRecord models for all entities per spec section 5. Add associations, validations, enums, scopes. Configure discard for soft deletes. Configure audited for meter readings, stays, manual entries. Write model specs.

title: Implement magic link authentication system
description: Build hand-rolled magic link auth (no Devise). Two controllers: SessionsController (request link, verify token, logout), TokensController (generate signed tokens). Mailer for magic link emails. Configure letter_opener for dev. Current user helper. Auth specs.

title: Create seed data for development
description: db/seeds.rb with: one property, two meters (main + secondary), 3-4 sample visitors, 2 users (one admin, one member). Include some sample stays and readings for testing. Idempotent seed script.
